therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: suppression of autoreactive T-cell activation and downstream autoimmune inflammation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with undifferentiated inflammatory arthritis at risk of developing rheumatoid arthritis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with a diagnosis of RA by ARA criteria and/or discontinued due to lack of efficacy at 12 months

results.effect_size: 12/28 abatacept vs 16/28 placebo developed RA at 12 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: Reduction in anti-CCP2 antibodies (mean change -94.5 vs +16.32 at 6 months), IL-6 (-4.49 vs +1.08 at 6 months), TNF-alpha (-1.70 vs +0.07 at 6 months), and MMP3T (-2.29 vs +14.34 at 6 months) in abatacept vs placebo arms
biomarker_changes: Anti-CCP2 antibodies: mean change -94.5 (abatacept) vs +16.32 (placebo) at 6 months
IL-6: mean change -4.49 (abatacept) vs +1.08 (placebo) at 6 months
TNF-alpha: mean change -1.70 (abatacept) vs +0.07 (placebo) at 6 months
MMP3T: mean change -2.29 (abatacept) vs +14.34 (placebo) at 6 months
DAS28-CRP mean change: -1.13 (abatacept) vs +0.01 (placebo) at 6 months
RF seropositive at baseline: 24/28 abatacept vs 20/28 placebo; RF at 6 months: 13/22 abatacept vs 14/20 placebo
MRI edema score change at 6 months: -1.64 (abatacept) vs +1.40 (placebo)
MRI synovitis score change at 6 months: +0.27 (abatacept) vs +1.60 (placebo)
subgroup_findings: At 24 months, 17/28 abatacept vs 21/28 placebo met RA diagnosis endpoint
Radiographic erosion score change at 12 months: +0.02 (abatacept) vs +0.85 (placebo)
SF-36 PCS mean change at 6 months: +10.23 (abatacept) vs +1.95 (placebo)
HAQ disability index response at 6 months: 16/26 abatacept vs 6/25 placebo
DAS28-CRP ≤3.2 at 6 months: 17/21 abatacept vs 9/20 placebo
DAS28-CRP <2.6 at 6 months: 15/21 abatacept vs 7/20 placebo
4 abatacept-treated participants had positive abatacept-specific antibodies
safety_signals: 1 SAE in each arm (sciatica in placebo; basal cell carcinoma in abatacept)
1 discontinuation due to AEs in each arm

context.indication: Undifferentiated inflammatory arthritis at risk of developing rheumatoid arthritis
